reviews.review:
Sadly I cannot recommend this game. 
At the core this is a fun puzzler/builder. I was enjoying the core gameplay in the early access version, and was looking forwards to the 1.0 release, but even after many months the game is still way too broken to be worth playing.

There are numerous bugs and error messages popping up during gameplay,
and worst of all the progression system seems entirely BROKEN, in that you aren't even rewarded the keys neccecary to unlock more seals, making any further gameplay completely pointless.

It would appear the developers got too busy with their real lives, and just released the unfinished game as 1.0, without any additional work put into it. 
The game even has a label in the corner stating that it's a development build!

If this was still early access I would have complete understanding for the games problems, but this is not the case.
